title: Fixed Open Ear Shell and Projecting Facebar Helmet
description: One newly authored complete empty football-style helmet exterior. A continuous thick crowned shell has a large open face, open lower neck and two real side ear ports. A separate coarse projecting face-bar assembly is rooted at both shell sides, with two broad bent horizontal bars and two short front vertical bars, not a dense domed fencing grid or a raised visor plate. A shallow concave chin cup and two fixed straps complete the static empty appearance. All geometry is opaque solid low-poly art, no wearer or imported old helmet numeric geometry. One whole model zero scenes. No impact protection, certification, fitting, wearing, materials specification, sporting suitability, mechanism or safety capability is claimed; rigging and animation not made.
